verdict.rationale: incident.io documents public status pages and Workflows that auto-publish to them when an incident is updated, so the status page is driven from incident state. A Status Page API also covers status page incidents and maintenance windows. However, the evidence never mentions custom domains or subscriber notifications, which are two explicit parts of the story. Missing for 10: custom domain support, subscriber notifications (email/SMS/webhook subscriptions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can publish a hosted public status page — custom domain, subscriber notifications — driven from incident state

citations.quote: We've built an easy and delightful way to communicate with customers during an incident with our public and private Status Pages.
With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
Automatically updating your status page means you can make your customers aware of problems immediately, and remove a step from your incident response process.
the Status Page API for programmatically managing incidents and maintenance windows
